AI Firm Anthropic Faces Scrutiny Over Risks and Funding

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly facing investigations by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) concerning potential risks to consumers. Concurrently, Anthropic is seeking a valuation exceeding $2 trillion and has secured a significant financing arrangement with Broadcom, which will lend the company up to $42 billion to lease Broadcom's chips. Anthropic has also flagged existential risks to humanity posed by AI.
